about.title: About Me
about.p1: I'm Francesco Saverio Conforti, an Automation, AI & Robotics Engineer from Italy. I specialize in building intelligent control systems, digital twins, and AI-driven automation tools for real industrial environments.
about.p2: My experience spans PLC programming, HVAC/BMS automation, reinforcement learning, robotics simulation, and machine learning applied to system optimization. I enjoy bridging industrial engineering with modern AI technologies such as PyTorch, ROS/ROS2, and advanced forecasting models.
about.p3: I'm passionate about solving complex engineering problems, designing scalable architectures, and creating systems that are reliable, efficient, and intelligent. Outside of engineering, I explore simulation, 3D graphics, and robotics research.

tiago_robot.title: Voice-Controlled Navigation & Autonomous Exploration on TIAGo Robot
result: Implemented a multimodal HRI system enabling navigation and motion control through voice commands, text input, and terminal-based interaction.
Integrated autonomous navigation with dynamic obstacle avoidance and reliable indoor localization.
Developed a custom exploration behavior allowing the robot to map unknown spaces while updating the occupancy grid in real time.
Automated the process of saving maps during exploration for reproducibility and environment reconstruction.
Created a semantic navigation layer mapping natural language room names to coordinate frames for intuitive human–robot interaction.
tiago_robot.dossier_desc: Narrative description of the TIAGo Robot project...

koopa_forecasting.title: Koopa Advanced: Energy Consumption Forecasting Pipeline
result: Implemented an end-to-end pipeline to preprocess and align weather data with energy consumption time series.
Used Koopa to track experiments, log training/validation metrics, and monitor gradient norms during model training.
Trained and tuned a deep learning model in PyTorch for short-term energy consumption forecasting using historical demand and weather features.
Achieved stable training dynamics and consistent validation performance, with documented metrics and experiment history managed through Koopa.
koopa_forecasting.dossier_desc: Narrative description of the Koopa Forecasting project...

maze_rl.title: Reinforcement Learning in a Custom Maze Environment
result: Designed a custom maze environment with curriculum learning via progressively increasing obstacles.
Implemented DDPG and SAC agents with convolutional policies for discrete navigation actions.
Integrated an HGR-based prioritized replay buffer to focus learning on high TD-error transitions.
Evaluated performance with multi-run, multi-level, and multi-goal benchmarks to compare robustness and success rates between DDPG and SAC.
maze_rl.dossier_desc: Narrative description of the Maze RL project...

cultural_classification.title: Multiclass Classification of Cultural Items Using Traditional ML and Transformers
result: Implemented a three-class classification system (Agnostic, Representative, Exclusive) using both a traditional ML ensemble and a DistilBERT-based transformer.
Engineered domain-inspired features, including a keyword-driven cultural_score, to improve traditional ML performance.
Developed an ensemble classifier combining Logistic Regression, Random Forest, and Linear SVM with majority voting to enhance robustness.
Fine-tuned DistilBERT on cultural metadata, achieving improved contextual understanding and the highest macro F1-score among tested models.
Compared model performance across accuracy, macro F1-score, computational cost, and inference time, highlighting trade-offs between speed and representational power.
cultural_classification.dossier_desc: Narrative description of the Cultural Classification project...

archaic_translation.title: Archaic-to-Modern Italian Translation with Prompt Engineering
result: Designed and compared multiple prompting strategies to handle the linguistic transformation from archaic to modern Italian.
Evaluated two different LLMs by analyzing translation accuracy using human scoring and visual metrics.
Built analytical tools to study score distributions and model behaviour under different prompt types.
Identified the limitations of small evaluation sets, API rate constraints, and domain bias, and proposed improvements such as larger datasets and fine-tuning.
archaic_translation.dossier_desc: Narrative description of the Archaic Translation project...

thermal_drift.title: Thermal Drift Prediction in Industrial Robotics Using Transformer Networks
result: Developed a complete experimental pipeline to model slow thermomechanical drift in a 3-DOF robotic platform.
Performed spectral and statistical analysis of thermal signals to identify long-term deformation patterns.
Engineered a robust set of thermal, temporal, and autoregressive features tailored for drift prediction.
Benchmarked classical ML models and a custom Transformer architecture, revealing strong axis-specific behaviours and different generalization capabilities.
Provided recommendations for better sensor placement and modelling strategies to enhance drift compensation in industrial robots.
thermal_drift.dossier_desc: Narrative description of the Thermal Drift project...

image_generation.title: Image Generation & Real-vs-Fake Classification Using GAN, Stable Diffusion and VGG16
result: Developed a full pipeline to compare real COCO images with generated ones using both a custom GAN and Stable Diffusion.
Implemented a GAN from scratch with five convolutional layers and 64×64 output resolution, tracking training progression across 100 epochs.
Used Stable Diffusion 2.1 to generate high-quality images from COCO captions for comparison with GAN outputs.
Built a binary classifier by combining VGG16 feature extraction with a custom SVM head, training separate SVM models for 64×64, 256×256, and compressed images.
Evaluated multiple generation and preprocessing conditions (GAN/Stable at different resolutions and compression levels) and produced a full benchmark using accuracy, precision, recall and F1-score.

Observed that Stable Diffusion at 256×256 provided the most distinguishable fake samples, achieving the highest classification scores, while low-resolution GAN images significantly reduced classifier performance.
image_generation.dossier_desc: Narrative description of the Image Generation project...

vehicle_simulation.title: Vehicle Driving Simulation with Multi-Input Steering, Motor Control and Wheel Physics
result: Developed a complete vehicle-control system integrating keyboard, on-screen joystick, physical joystick, and accelerometer/gyroscope steering inputs.
Implemented an accelerator module supporting forward drive, reverse gear logic, and dynamic switching between input sources (press button, joystick axis, keyboard arrows).
Built a custom handbrake system with toggle logic and safety checks, allowing stationary locking and gradual braking based on user input.
Created a full driving model using WheelColliders with torque, brake force, and steering angle calculations, synchronized to visible wheel meshes for realistic behaviour.
Added gyroscopic steering for mobile devices, enabling tilt-based directional control through Unity's hardware sensor APIs.
Integrated UI-based steering wheel with clamped angle values, allowing dynamic switching between steering modes (touch wheel, accelerometer, joystick).
Designed modular input components to allow quick substitution or combination of control methods for testing multiple driving configurations.

project2.title: 3D Sundial Simulation with Real-Time Sun Positioning — Built Using WebGL
project2.desc: A live WebGL simulation calculating real solar vectors for accurate shadows and dynamic lighting.

project3.title: Frequency Analysis of Thermal Signals for Predicting Thermal Drift in Industrial Robotics
project3.desc: Research and implementation of a frequency-domain analysis pipeline (FFT and spectral models) applied to thermal signals from industrial robots, aimed at predicting axis thermal drift to improve positioning accuracy. The project includes sensor data acquisition, preprocessing, frequency-domain feature engineering, and the development of predictive models for dynamic error compensation.
